headline: Instagram put an 'AI content' label on a photo set that Tiffany Trump posted, without saying which image triggered it.
score_reason: Celebrity trivia; event was 1 Oct 2026, before the window.
importance_line: It matters little beyond showing that Instagram's AI labels reach everyday posts; the Daily Mail's suggestion that she used AI editing is an inference.
summary: The Daily Mail reports that Instagram flagged a 'Scenes from September' photo carousel posted by Tiffany Trump on Thursday 1 Oct 2026 as containing 'AI content', without identifying which picture. The paper says she appeared to have used AI editing, but that is its reading, not a statement from her, and IMDb has since carried the story.
notes: Pool link was the IMDb page (no text); url is the Daily Mail original.
